candidate_merges.message: Fix 404 when switching language in the previous dashboard (#22261) ## Description Switching language in the previous dashboard (Settings > Language, with the previous experience selected) showed a 404 page. The settings dialog navigates to `/api/set-language?language=...&redirectUrl=...` with a forced page load, the same as the new dashboard. The legacy layout registers a location-changing handler that rewrites unprefixed navigations below `/legacy`, so links shared with the new experience stay

pull_request.title: Fix 404 when switching language in the previous dashboard

candidate_merges.message: Fix clipped graph controls and hide the game in the previous dashboard (#22264) ## Description In the previous dashboard experience, the resource graph controls (export, zoom in, zoom out, reset) were clipped by the bottom of the viewport and couldn't be clicked. The graph sized its SVG `viewBox` from `.resources-summary-layout`. On the new overview that element contains only the graph, but on the previous experience's Resources page it also contains the tab header row. The SVG had no CSS height

pull_request.title: Fix clipped graph controls and hide the game in the previous dashboard

candidate_merges.message: Show only the absolute time in dashboard relative-time tooltips (#22263) ## Description Tooltips on relative times in the new dashboard repeated the text they were attached to, for example `Started 1m ago (11/13/2026 8:30:43 AM)` on a row that already reads "Started 1m ago". They now show only the exact time, in a browser-like medium format: `Nov 13, 2026, 11:03 AM`. Affected tooltips: - Resource rows, in the sidebar and in the full resource list.
